evidence.finding: El grafo de llamadas confirma que checkout depende de payment y que paymentUnreachable afecta a checkout.
evidence.summary: Store call graph (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-demo/blob/1755859a9de82c2e5e225be68abc401a5ebf2b4f/compose.yaml): checkout calls cart, currency, email, payment, product-catalog and shipping (CART_ADDR, CURRENCY_ADDR, EMAIL_ADDR, PAYMENT_ADDR, PRODUCT_CATALOG_ADDR, SHIPPING_ADDR). checkout depends on payment: every order charges the card through payment, so the flagd feature flags paymentFailure (read by payment) and paymentUnreachable (read by checkout) both fail checkout orders. Source: compose.yaml service checkout (line 114).

evidence.finding: La documentación indica que paymentUnreachable hace que checkout falle Charge sin llegar a payment, con errores iguales y payment silencioso.
evidence.summary: How checkout places an order (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-demo/blob/1755859a9de82c2e5e225be68abc401a5ebf2b4f/src/checkout/main.go): The flagd feature flag paymentUnreachable is read by checkout, not by payment. When on, checkout sends the charge to badAddress:50051 instead of payment, so PaymentService/Charge fails inside checkout and payment receives no request and records no error. Symptom: checkout PlaceOrder and PaymentService/Charge errors in equal numbers, payment quiet. Source: src/checkout/main.go chargeCard (lines 565-578).

evidence.finding: Con paymentFailure los errores aparecerían también en payment, y las métricas no muestran errores de payment, así que este flag no explica el patrón observado.
evidence.summary: Flags read by payment (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-demo/blob/1755859a9de82c2e5e225be68abc401a5ebf2b4f/src/payment/charge.js): The flagd feature flag paymentFailure is read by payment on every charge. Its value is a fraction (variants 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 90% and 100%; the variant named 90% is 0.95); payment fails that share of charges with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. demo.user_context.loyalty_level=gold', logs it as a warning and sets its span to error. The error propagates to checkout, whose PlaceOrder fails with 'failed to charge card'. Symptom: errors in payment and in checkout together, unlike paymentUnreachable. Source: src/payment/charge.js (lines 39-47), src/payment/index.js (lines 24-28), src/flagd/demo.flagd.json.

hypotheses.statement: La causa es el flag de fallo paymentUnreachable activo (variant on) en checkout. Mecanismo: checkout envía el cargo a badAddress:50051 en lugar de payment, así que PaymentService/Charge falla dentro de checkout y payment no recibe ninguna solicitud. Esto produce errores iguales en PlaceOrder y Charge, con payment sin errores. Se refutaría si payment registra solicitudes Charge o errores propios en el mismo periodo, o si los errores de checkout siguen igual con paymentUnreachable en off.

mitigation_strategy.description: Desactivar el flag paymentUnreachable en checkout para que checkout vuelva a enviar los cargos a payment en lugar de badAddress:50051.
steps: Ejecutar flag.set en el servicio checkout con flag=paymentUnreachable y variant=off.
mitigation_strategy.verification_check: Confirmar que el ratio de spans con STATUS_CODE_ERROR de checkout baja por debajo del umbral del 5% y que PlaceOrder y PaymentService/Charge dejan de fallar en checkout.
